# Test media

Follow [test guidance](../AGENTS.md) and the [milestone spec](../../spec.md).

- Never commit identifiable workout footage or personal absolute paths.
- Do not put test media in `public/`, where Vite would serve it to everyone.
- An accepted human fixture needs recorded permission, SHA-256, actual metadata,
  and three manually inspected timestamps; no placeholder manifest.
- Distinguish internally generated no-person patterns from real bench footage.
- Do not fabricate anatomical alignment, person identity, or model accuracy.
